summary: Live mobile Expo preview loaded, role access and citizen SOS flow were exercised. SOS persisted and rendered ACTIVE EMERGENCY after server response; health/readiness and full API workflow were previously verified in the supplied context. Mobile SOS composer has a blocking viewport issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal content is not wrapped in a scrollable container. At 390x844, the Medical/type controls and CONFIRM SOS are outside the viewport and Playwright cannot tap them normally; the flow only completes with forced clicks.
On a 390px viewport, the ACKNOWLEDGED badge visibly extends/clips beyond the right edge of the status card.

integration_issues.issue: The implementation reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the workspace contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL. The current .env happens to define the public variant, but deployments providing only the required key will produce an empty API base URL.

action_items: Wrap SOS composer body in a ScrollView (or otherwise fit controls) while retaining keyboard-safe behavior.
Constrain or reposition StatusCard header/badge so it cannot overflow at 390px width.
Support the mandated EXPO_BACKEND_URL key in crisis-api.ts and preserve the current configured key only as compatibility fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive role buttons and logout icon lack testID attributes, reducing reliable automated coverage.
Responder location watcher is hardcoded to responder-alpha rather than the logged-in session user_id; this can update the wrong responder for other responder sessions.

success_rate.backend: 100% for supplied/observed core workflow; health/readiness returned successfully in prior verification

seed_data_creation: Created one test SOS through the live citizen UI; demo data was reset before the clean run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use 390x844. Reset via POST /api/demo/reset before citizen UI testing. The SOS modal requires forced clicks because controls are below the viewport; verify normal taps after ScrollView fix.
rca_of_issue: SosComposer renders a tall View directly inside KeyboardAvoidingView with modalCard maxHeight 90%, but no ScrollView. On mobile the lower controls are clipped/non-tappable. StatusCard uses a horizontal statusTop row without sufficient shrink/wrapping for its title and badge.
